edges.mechanism: UA inhibits arachidonic-acid-triggered platelet aggregation (IC50 3.7 uM, thromboxane A2 pathway) and potentiated the antiplatelet effect of acetylsalicylic acid in human whole blood; possible additive antiplatelet effect.
edges.evidence: In vitro human whole-blood aggregometry (n=17 donors); glucuronide inactive; no in vivo data; low/very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Antiplatelet activity of UA aglycone across multiple agonists (collagen, ADP, PAF, TRAP); theoretical additive bleeding risk.
edges.evidence: In vitro only; clinical relevance unconfirmed

edges.mechanism: Pomegranate juice (ellagitannin precursor source of UA) was associated with INR change on starting/stopping; proposed CYP inhibition by pomegranate constituents. Not shown for purified UA.
edges.evidence: Single case report (DIPS possible) plus reviews; applies to pomegranate juice, not UA supplements

edges.mechanism: Pomegranate constituents inhibit CYP3A4/CYP2C9 in vitro and in animals; human relevance not established; no data for purified UA.
edges.evidence: Reviews of in vitro, animal and limited clinical studies of pomegranate juice

edges.mechanism: UA is a direct AhR ligand (antagonist in human reporter cells, attenuating TCDD-induced CYP1A1; agonist-like in gut epithelium) and induced CYP1A1/UGT1A10 in Caco-2 cells.
edges.evidence: In vitro and rodent data; in vivo CYP1A1 induction not seen with oral dosing in rats

edges.mechanism: UA cytotoxic to myeloma cells and synergistic with bortezomib, including bortezomib-resistant cells.
edges.evidence: In vitro and xenograft data plus retrospective cohort of 45 patients; preclinical

edges.mechanism: UA chemosensitized 5-FU-resistant colon cancer cells by downregulating MDR1, BCRP, MRP2 and MRP7 efflux transporters via FOXO3-FOXM1.
edges.evidence: Cell and mouse xenograft/AOM-DSS models; preclinical

edges.mechanism: Additive antiproliferative effect with bicalutamide in LNCaP cells but attenuated pro-apoptotic activity; authors advise caution in complementary prostate cancer therapy.
Combination UA + cyclosporine A reduced anti-dsDNA IgG, immune complex deposition and renal inflammation more than either alone.
Complementary mechanisms: UA induces PINK1/Parkin mitophagy, spermidine induces broader autophagy via AMPK/SIRT1.
NAD+ supplementation and UA both stimulate mitophagy and reversed memory impairment in AD models; UA and NMN are co-prescribed by gerotype in a precision geromedicine protocol.
edges.evidence: Animal data and a feasibility protocol without outcomes; no combination efficacy data

edges.mechanism: Dietary ellagitannins/ellagic acid are converted to UA by gut bacteria in producers (metabotype A/B); direct UA gives >6-fold higher plasma exposure than pomegranate juice.
edges.evidence: Human intervention trials; conversion is metabotype-dependent

edges.mechanism: 24-strain synbiotic with 400 mg pomegranate extract increased urinary UA 49-fold and converted 100% of participants into UA producers (vs 44.4% placebo).
edges.evidence: RCT n=32, 91 days; increases endogenous production rather than combining with UA supplements

edges.mechanism: FOS plus ellagic acid synergistically increased gut UA biosynthesis (Bifidobacterium pseudolongum to Enterococcus faecalis cross-feeding) and muscle endurance.
Non-producers (5-25%) make no UA from dietary ellagitannins; direct supplementation bypasses microbiome variability.
edges.evidence: Pooled intervention trials and RCT of UA vs pomegranate juice

edges.mechanism: UA (poorly soluble) identified as a component (5-80%) of calcium oxalate/phosphate urinary stones in 8 patients with high dietary walnut/berry intake; none took UA supplements.
edges.evidence: Case series (lab-based), 2026; risk with supplements unstudied

edges.mechanism: UA binds ERalpha/ERbeta (IC50 0.4/0.75 uM) with weak estrogenic and antiestrogenic activity and SERM-like behaviour.
edges.evidence: In vitro and animal data; no clinical harm reported
